title: nicoaira/ginflow pipeline parameters
description: Nextflow pipeline for BLAST-style search over RNA secondary structures using GINFINITY embeddings and FAISS seeding.

input.description: Structures table used to build the FAISS database. Required columns: transcript_id, sequence, secondary_structure. Optional start/end columns (0-based half-open; comma-separated lists for several windows) build one independent subject per window. Extra columns are allowed. Omit when searching an existing --database.

query.description: Structures table to search. Same columns as --input, including optional start/end windows. Each window is an independent query. Omit for a build-only run.

database.description: Existing faiss/ directory from a previous run (index.faiss, windows.tsv, meta.json). Use with --query. Do not combine with --input.

outdir.description: Output directory for graphs, embeddings, windows, the FAISS database, and seeds.

shard_size.description: Maximum number of input TSV rows per BUILD_RNA_GRAPHS job. A row with several start/end windows expands to several graphs inside that shard.

id_column.description: Column name for the molecule identifier.

sequence_column.description: Column name for the RNA sequence.

structure_column.description: Column name for the dot-bracket secondary structure.

start_column.description: Optional 0-based half-open window start column. Empty cell = full molecule. A comma-separated list (e.g. 34,40) pairs with --end_column to make several independent subjects from one row.

end_column.description: Optional 0-based half-open window end column. Must be present whenever --start_column is. Same number of comma-separated values as start.

no_slices.description: Ignore start/end columns and encode every row as a full molecule.

keep_paired_neighbours.description: For a start/end window, keep bases outside the core that are paired with a core nucleotide so they take part in message passing. Embeddings still contain only the core.

context_hops.description: How far to expand around crossing-pair partners when --keep_paired_neighbours is set. 1 = the partner only; higher values also take neighbouring nucleotides. Does not change embedding length.

delimiter.description: Field delimiter of the structures table.

embed_device.description: Documented embed device. CUDA requires -profile gpu, which sets accelerator=1 on EMBED_RNA_GRAPHS and selects the GPU Wave image.

window_size.description: Sliding-window length in nucleotides. Each window is the concatenation of this many 128-d residue vectors.

seed_k.description: Maximum neighbours kept per query window before applying --seed_min_similarity.

seed_min_similarity.description: Minimum cosine similarity (L2-normalized window inner product) required to keep a seed.

search_shard_size.description: Query records per SEARCH_FAISS job. Defaults to --shard_size. Does not change database graph/embed shards. Ignored when --input and --query are the same file (search reuses the database shards).

faiss_index.description: FAISS index type from https://github.com/facebookresearch/faiss/wiki/Faiss-indexes. Default FlatIP is exact cosine search on L2-normalized windows. IVF*/PQ/HNSW/LSH/SQ are approximate. GPU (--faiss_gpu) supports FlatIP, FlatL2, IVFFlat, IVFPQ, and IVFSQ only.

faiss_gpu.description: Build and search the FAISS index on GPU when the type supports it. Requires -profile gpu (faiss-gpu image + NVIDIA runtime). Raises an error if the profile is missing or the index type has no GPU implementation.

faiss_nlist.description: IVF coarse centroids (IVFFlat, IVFPQ, IVFSQ, IVFPQR). Unset = min(4*sqrt(n), n/39, n).

faiss_nprobe.description: IVF lists visited at search time. Unset = min(8, nlist) at build, or the value stored in meta.json at search.

faiss_pq_m.description: Product-quantizer subvectors for PQ, IVFPQ, and IVFPQR. Must divide the window dimension (1408 when --window_size 11).

faiss_pq_m_refine.description: Extra PQ codes used to rerank IVFPQR hits.

faiss_hnsw_ef_search.description: HNSW search exploration depth. Also applied at search time.

faiss_lsh_nbits.description: LSH code length in bits. Unset = 2 * window_dim.

faiss_sq_type.description: Scalar quantizer width for SQ and IVFSQ.

cluster_span.description: Maximum nucleotide gap, on query and target, between a seed and the current cluster box.

cluster_min_seeds.description: Minimum seeds required to keep a cluster.

cluster_diagonal_tolerance.description: Allowed diagonal drift (query_start - target_start) when adding a seed.

cluster_max_diagonal_span.description: Maximum diagonal breadth of a cluster. 0 disables the cap.

cluster_max_seed_rank.description: Ignore FAISS hits worse than this rank. 0 keeps every seed.

align_pad.description: Nucleotides of context added on each side of a cluster before GINFINITY-SW.

align_max_cells.description: Maximum DP cells (crop length product) allowed for one cluster.

evd_samples.description: Reverse-sequence null alignments used to fit Karlin–Altschul λ and K.

evd_max_length.description: Crop each null sequence to this length so EVD calibration stays O(L^2).

evd_seed.description: RNG seed for reverse-sequence null sampling.

plot_backend.description: Draw aligned regions with RNArtistCore 2Ds, a unified R4RNA alignment arc plot, both, or skip plotting.

plot_sw.description: Draw crop cosine and substitution-score matrices, with the Smith–Waterman traceback on the score plot.

plot_max_pairs.description: Maximum alignment pairs to plot per query. RNArtistCore writes query and target 2Ds; R4RNA writes one alignment arc plot; SW writes cosine and score matrices.

plot_highlight_colour.description: Colour of the aligned span, shared R4RNA pairs, matching bases, and the SW traceback. Default is nf-core green.

report_theme.description: Colour theme of report.html. Light (gray-100 page, white cards) is the default; pass dark for a gray-900 report. The page also has a theme toggle.
